items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I never heard that — yes I did, on a cruise when I heard that big band of Illinois’. It’s good, isn’t it?

ctx.x: I saw Illinois there. It’s a pretty big place just for piano it seems like.
I never heard that — yes I did, on a cruise when I heard that big band of Illinois’. It’s good, isn’t it?
We saw you on a cruise. A few years ago.
